coverage: Complete novella in both English editions: named people, contextual household roles and named cultural references. Shared names are resolved by passage; hypothetical legal cases and commercial place names excluded.

entities.name: Ivan Ilyich Golovin
entities.body: The judge whose life and death the novella follows; Praskovya Fedorovna’s husband.

entities.name: Praskovya Fedorovna
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s wife and the mother of Lisa and Vasya.

entities.name: Gerasim
entities.body: The young assistant to the Golovins’ butler, who also nurses Ivan Ilyich.

entities.name: Peter Ivanovich
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s colleague and old friend from law school.

entities.name: Lisa
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich and Praskovya Fedorovna’s daughter.

entities.name: Vasya
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich and Praskovya Fedorovna’s schoolboy son.

entities.name: Fedor Petrovich Petrishchev
entities.body: The young examining magistrate engaged to Lisa; Dmitri Ivanovich Petrishchev’s son.

entities.name: Dmitri Ivanovich Petrishchev
entities.body: The father of Fedor Petrovich, Lisa’s suitor.

entities.name: Ivan Egorovich Shebek
entities.body: A colleague of Ivan Ilyich at the law courts.

entities.name: Fedor Vasilievich
entities.body: A colleague of Ivan Ilyich and one of his closer acquaintances.

entities.name: Schwartz
entities.body: A colleague and card-playing acquaintance of Ivan Ilyich and Peter Ivanovich.

entities.name: Sokolov
entities.body: The Golovins’ butler, senior to Gerasim.

entities.name: Peter
entities.body: A footman in Ivan Ilyich’s household.

entities.name: Dmitri
entities.body: A servant in Ivan Ilyich’s household.

entities.name: Ilya Epimovich Golovin
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s father, a senior government official.

entities.name: Baron Greff
entities.body: The government official married to Ivan Ilyich’s sister.

entities.name: Ivan Ilyich’s sister
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s sister, married to Baron Greff.

entities.name: Praskovya’s brother
entities.body: Praskovya Fedorovna’s brother, Ivan Ilyich’s brother-in-law.

entities.name: Alexeev
entities.body: A court official considered for Ivan Ilyich’s position.

entities.name: Vinnikov
entities.body: A court official mentioned in the discussion of possible promotions.

entities.name: Shtabel
entities.body: A court official mentioned in the discussion of possible promotions.

entities.name: Happe
entities.body: The official who receives the judicial appointment Ivan Ilyich had expected.

entities.name: F. I. Ilyin
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s acquaintance, who brings news of changes at the ministry.

entities.name: Peter Ivanovich, the ministry official
entities.body: The official being replaced in the ministry; distinct from Ivan Ilyich’s friend of the same name.

entities.name: Ivan Semonovich
entities.body: The official expected to replace Peter Ivanovich at the ministry.

entities.name: Peter Petrovich
entities.body: An official whose advancement helps Ivan Ilyich’s prospects.

entities.name: Zachar Ivanovich
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s friend and colleague, able to help him obtain an appointment.

entities.name: Miller
entities.body: The official whose position Zachar Ivanovich takes.

entities.name: Princess Trufonova
entities.body: A fashionable guest with whom Ivan Ilyich dances.

entities.name: Mikhail Mikhaylovich
entities.body: Ivan Ilyich’s bridge partner.

entities.name: Nikolaevich
entities.body: One of the doctors whose opinions on Ivan Ilyich’s illness are discussed.

entities.name: Leshchetitsky
entities.body: The celebrated medical specialist whom Praskovya proposes consulting.

entities.name: Michael Danilovich
entities.body: The doctor attending Ivan Ilyich during his illness.

entities.name: The visiting specialist
entities.body: The doctor brought in to consult with Michael Danilovich.

entities.name: Helen
entities.body: A companion joining the family’s theater outing; her relationship to them is not specified.

entities.name: Mitya
entities.body: A person in Ivan Ilyich’s childhood memories; the passage does not specify the relationship.

entities.name: Volodya
entities.body: A person in Ivan Ilyich’s childhood memories; the passage does not specify the relationship.

entities.name: Katenka
entities.body: A woman in Ivan Ilyich’s memories of his youth; no further identity is given.

entities.name: Scharmer
entities.body: The fashionable tailor from whom Ivan Ilyich buys his clothes.

entities.name: Empress Marya
entities.body: The Russian empress whose name is borne by the charitable and educational institutions mentioned here.

entities.name: Émile Zola
entities.body: The French novelist whose work Ivan Ilyich tries to read.

entities.name: Kiesewetter
entities.body: The German philosopher and author of the logic textbook Ivan Ilyich remembers.

entities.name: Caius
entities.body: The example of a mortal man used in the logic textbook’s argument.

entities.name: Sarah Bernhardt
entities.body: The celebrated French stage actress the family plans to see.

entities.name: Capoul
entities.body: The French tenor Victor Capoul, whose hairstyle Fedor Petrovich imitates.

entities.name: Adrienne Lecouvreur
entities.body: The French actress whose life is dramatized in the play discussed by the theatergoers.

entities.name: The Church Reader
entities.body: The man reading aloud during the funeral service.

entities.name: The priest
entities.body: The priest conducting religious rites for the family.
